businessObjective: Position Forge Rehab & Performance as a one-on-one, evidence-based, progressive physical therapy practice for active people in Northern New Jersey, using Recover / Build / Perform to make the path beyond symptom relief clear while keeping booking disabled until a real scheduling URL exists.

demoRouteContract.behavior: Only Home and Forge Approach navigate. Planned routes are visibly labeled, non-interactive, and never use fake destinations.

concepts.name: Cinematic Clinic
concepts.goal: Establish premium clinical credibility for active people who want a structured return beyond symptom relief.
concepts.primaryConversion: Book an Evaluation, visibly disabled with Online scheduling coming soon.
concepts.heroStrategy: A full-frame strength crop and controlled dark overlay lead with Ready is more than pain-free, followed by a functional Forge Approach link and an explicit disabled booking state.
concepts.navigationStrategy: Compact technical header with active Home and Forge Approach links; every future production route appears as a Planned non-link to communicate architecture without dead ends.
concepts.hierarchyStrategy: Lead with the image-led premise, establish one-on-one care and verified credentials in a compact proof band, then move through clinical pathways, the progression, practitioner authority, and conversion readiness.
concepts.ctaStrategy: One restrained gold booking control above the fold and one final disabled state; Forge Approach is the functional secondary action.
concepts.serviceStrategy: Frame Recover / Build / Perform as a numbered clinical progression and summarize rehabilitation, return-to-activity, and performance pathways without inventing assessments or devices.
concepts.socialProofStrategy: Use only verified practitioner credentials, one-on-one care, the approved progression, and transparent provenance; no reviews, outcomes, ratings, or patient counts.
concepts.imageryStrategy: High-contrast documentary movement photography with precise crops and technical overlays. Any stock remains atmospheric demo material and must not imply Forge patients, facilities, treatment, or outcomes.
concepts.typographyDirection: Narrow engineered display typography, legible grotesk body, restrained uppercase annotations, and strong numeric stage markers.
concepts.layoutDirection: Disciplined asymmetric grid, sharp rules, generous black fields, protocol diagrams, and controlled density; the Approach route reads like a progression standard rather than a duplicate homepage.
concepts.motionDirection: Short linear reveals, line-drawing accents, and restrained image transitions with no bounce, parallax, decorative gauges, or motion-dependent meaning.
sections: Cinematic image-led hero and disabled booking action
concepts.approachRouteStrategy: Six compact modules present the premise, a numbered Recover / Build / Perform progression rail, decision principles, audience applications, expectations, and a final disabled booking action without invented tests or metrics.

concepts.name: Performance Journal
concepts.goal: Make Forge's clinical reasoning and individualized process understandable before asking the visitor to act.
concepts.primaryConversion: Book an Evaluation, visibly disabled with Online scheduling coming soon.
concepts.heroStrategy: A warm editorial opening pairs Recovery is a starting point, not the finish line with a deliberate court crop, clear booking status, and a functional reading path to Forge Approach.
concepts.navigationStrategy: A calm publication-style masthead keeps Home and Forge Approach functional and sets future production routes as clearly marked Planned folio items.
concepts.hierarchyStrategy: Move from premise to a concise evidence folio, audience recognition, numbered progression journal, practitioner context, and next-step readiness in a measured reading sequence.
concepts.ctaStrategy: A quiet brass disabled action appears once near the opening and once at the close; Read the Forge Approach is the functional secondary action and primary exploration path.
concepts.serviceStrategy: Explain Recover / Build / Perform as a numbered editorial journal with plain-language stage goals, fine rules, and readable annotations.
concepts.socialProofStrategy: Earn trust through clarity, verified credentials, transparent owner-approved facts, and explicit unknowns rather than testimonials or outcome claims.
concepts.imageryStrategy: Restrained court and runner crops support the editorial reading sequence. Stock is labeled as demo atmosphere and reserved for production replacement or licensing confirmation.
concepts.typographyDirection: Editorial serif headlines, compact sans-serif navigation and notes, readable body measure, modest folio labels, and no ornamental italics that weaken clarity.
concepts.layoutDirection: Warm paper, charcoal ink, muted ochre, fine editorial rules, margin notes, folios, and measured reading passages without a literal blueprint grid.
concepts.motionDirection: Subtle progress-line drawing, calm section fades, deliberate underline states, and complete reduced-motion parity.
sections: Editorial premise hero and disabled booking action
concepts.approachRouteStrategy: Six journal modules cover the premise, assessment-to-progression sequence, decision principles, audience-specific applications, expectations and FAQ, and the unavailable booking state using margin notes and numbered folios.

concepts.name: Training Culture
concepts.goal: Create immediate emotional identification for athletes, lifters, parents, and active adults who want their life back, not only less pain.
concepts.primaryConversion: Book an Evaluation, visibly disabled with Online scheduling coming soon.
concepts.heroStrategy: A split runner crop and condensed Recovery is the start. Train forward. statement make activity and ambition immediate while the disabled booking state remains explicit.
concepts.navigationStrategy: Bold compact navigation gives Home and Forge Approach decisive active states; planned production routes read as stamped Planned labels rather than links.
concepts.hierarchyStrategy: Begin with the activity-led premise, establish the care model in a bold proof band, recognize audience pursuits, translate them into Recover / Build / Perform, and ground the direction in Brandon's verified expertise and an honest next-step state.
concepts.ctaStrategy: A high-contrast disabled booking block above the fold and a strong final close; Explore the Forge Approach remains the functional route for interested visitors.
concepts.serviceStrategy: Connect each approved stage to human goals and activity demands without promising outcomes, showing readiness tests, or implying depicted people are patients.
concepts.socialProofStrategy: Use Brandon's verified credentials and owner-approved philosophy as the trust anchor; make the absence of reviews and outcome data invisible rather than replacing them with fabricated proof.
concepts.imageryStrategy: High-contrast grayscale runner, strength, and court crops show generic active-life moments, never treatment or Forge facilities. Production requires real licensed or owner-approved imagery and clear replacement review.
concepts.typographyDirection: Oversized condensed display statements, sturdy sans-serif body, cropped words used with accessible text intact, and short line lengths for force without fatigue.
concepts.layoutDirection: Near-black and off-white fields, electric-lime direction, staggered cards, hard typographic shifts, and compact activity-led modules within the shared spacing contract.
concepts.motionDirection: Purposeful image masks, typographic wipes, and responsive transitions; no aggressive autoplay, continuous marquee, or compromised reading comfort.
sections: Runner-led Train Forward hero and disabled booking action
concepts.approachRouteStrategy: Six compact sports-editorial modules pair the premise, staggered Recover / Build / Perform progression, decision principles, activity applications, expectations and FAQ, and the unavailable booking state with concise approved statements.
